policy: References informed taxonomy, adult shell size, shell proportions (spire angle, knob row, lip flare, stromboid notch, canal), soft-part layout (long eyestalks with the sensory filament, proboscis, sickle operculum) and the leaping gait only. No pixels were sampled, traced, copied or redistributed. Seller imagery was not used as a texture or tracing source; the trade name Fighting Conch was used for identity only.
taxonomy: Trade name covers Strombus alatus Gmelin, 1791 and Strombus pugilis Linnaeus, 1758. WoRMS/MolluscaBase (accessed 2026-09-03) lists S. alatus as a junior subjective synonym of S. pugilis; the asset therefore carries a genus-level scientificLabel (Strombus sp.) with taxonomyConfidence genus.

referenceGradeRationale: Taxonomy and maximum shell size are authoritative (WoRMS, Malacolog via Wikipedia, GSMFC guide). Shell proportions come from openly licensed apertural and dorsal shell photographs; the live soft-part layout (eyestalk length, proboscis, operculum) and the resting shell attitude are inferred from live-animal photographs and general strombid anatomy rather than calibrated side/top/front references.
